question.text: Per the SIA workbook, which body is named as the self-regulatory organisation (SRO) for Social Impact Assessors?

answer.text: The Institute of Social Auditors of India, set up under the aegis of ICAI, or such other agency as SEBI may specify
Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI), acting in its own name as the SRO
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), acting in its own name as the SRO
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), acting directly as the SRO

explanation.text: The Logic: The SIA workbook identifies the SRO for Social Impact Assessors as the Institute of Social Auditors of India, set up under the aegis of ICAI, or such other agency as SEBI may specify. SEBI may notify additional SROs (footnotes reference the ICMAI Social Auditors Organization and the ICSI Institute of Social Auditors), but the named body in the workbook is the ICAI-aegis Institute of Social Auditors of India. The Trap: ICMAI, ICSI and SEBI itself are not the SRO in their own name. Cost accountants and company secretaries may be empanelled as SIAs through their respective institutes' arms, but the SRO body named in the workbook is the ICAI-aegis Institute of Social Auditors of India. Note: The item was rewritten to use the workbook's source wording ("Institute of Social Auditors of India under the aegis of ICAI") in place of the non-source "ICAI SIAB" nomenclature, and the duplicate ICAI SIAB options were replaced with distinct distractors. The unsupported Cross-Exam Context and Pro-Tip paragraphs were removed.
